campbell.title: Campbell City Council — July 7, 2026
campbell.summary: The Campbell City Council reviewed an updated interim ordinance related to state Senate legislation and held public hearings on revoking the business and tobacco permits for two local shops, California Cigar and Hayes Smoke Shop. The council also considered applying for a 'One Big Beautiful' area grant for public works projects and approving new consultant service agreements.
keyTopics: Interim ordinance updating implementation of a state Senate law
Public hearing to revoke business license and tobacco retailer permit for California Cigar
Public hearing to revoke business license and tobacco retailer permit for Hayes Smoke Shop
Public Works Director seeking approval to submit a grant application
Approval of new consultant service agreements

saratoga.title: Saratoga City Council — May 6, 2026
saratoga.summary: The Saratoga City Council will hold a public hearing and vote on preliminary approval of an annual assessment engineer's report and a related resolution of intention, with a follow-up ordinance planned for adoption at the May 20 meeting. Council members will also discuss whether Saratoga should consider becoming a charter city and review early estimates of possible new local tax options and how much revenue each could generate.
keyTopics: Preliminary approval of the Engineer's Report and Resolution of Intention for an assessment district
Public hearing on the assessment/engineer's report
Ordinance scheduled for adoption at the May 20, 2026 meeting
Discussion of charter city status and next steps
Review of potential new tax options and revenue estimates for the city

los-gatos.title: Los Gatos Town Council — April 21, 2026
los-gatos.summary: The Los Gatos Town Council's April 21, 2026 meeting covers routine business like approving prior meeting minutes and reviewing February's financial report, alongside approving a construction contract and a new three-year professional services agreement. The council will also hear a court-ordered appeal and take public comment on select agenda items.
keyTopics: Construction contract award to QLM, Inc.
Resolution to begin planning a town improvement project
New three-year professional services agreement
Second amendment to an existing town agreement
Court-ordered hearing on appeals

san-jose.title: San José City Council — June 23, 2026
san-jose.summary: The San José City Council met to approve routine meeting minutes and consider a few business items. Key actions included updating a retail concession agreement at the airport, adjusting airport fees and charges, and approving the City Manager's business trip to Tampa, Florida.
keyTopics: Approval of City Council and Council Committee meeting minutes
Amendment to retail merchandising concession agreement with PRI-San José, LLC
Changes to Airport Fees and Charges Rate schedule
City Manager's approved travel to Tampa, Florida

mountain-view.title: Mountain View City Council — June 23, 2026
mountain-view.summary: The Mountain View City Council met to handle several honorary recognitions, including proclamations for National Immigrant Heritage Month, the Kiwanis Club's 100th anniversary, and City Attorney Jennifer Logue's new judicial appointment. On the business side, the Council reviewed the city's annual budget limits and financial policies, adopted an updated long-term water management plan, and approved next year's capital improvement projects, including work on the Public Safety Building and Shoreline Golf Links parking lot.
keyTopics: Proclamations honoring Immigrant Heritage Month, the Kiwanis Club's centennial, and City Attorney Jennifer Logue's judicial appointment
Closed-session discussion on potential litigation exposure
Approval of the FY 2026-27 spending limit and updates to financial/budget policy
Adoption of the 5-Year Urban Water Management and Water Shortage Contingency Plan
Capital projects update covering the Public Safety Building, Shoreline Golf Links repaving, and South Bay Salt Pond Restoration

sunnyvale.title: Sunnyvale City Council — July 21, 2026
sunnyvale.summary: Sunnyvale's City Council held a study session and regular meeting covering routine city business, including approving past meeting minutes and payment records. Council also considered a proposal to stop using chemical pesticides on city-owned or leased property, and approved contracts for library materials and a major repair project at the water treatment plant.
keyTopics: Proposal to eliminate chemical pesticide use on city-owned or leased property
$1,391,426 contract awarded to Brannon Corporation to repair levees at the Water Pollution Control Plant's oxidation ponds
Updated agreement with Brodart Co. to supply library books and shelf-ready materials
Approval of city payment records and June 16 meeting minutes
Special study session held earlier in the evening before the regular meeting

cupertino.title: Cupertino City Council — July 21, 2026
cupertino.summary: The Cupertino City Council held a closed-door session with its attorneys to discuss three ongoing lawsuits against the city. No public votes or discussion on the merits occur during this type of closed meeting, since it's meant for legal strategy talks.
keyTopics: Lawsuit: Lixin (Leon) Chen, et al. v. City of Cupertino
Lawsuit: Yes in My Backyard, et al. v. City of Cupertino
Lawsuit: Garden Gate Coalition for Mary Avenue Safety v. City of Cupertino
Closed-session legal strategy discussion with city attorneys

santa-clara.title: Santa Clara City Council — June 23, 2026
santa-clara.summary: This notice covers procedural details for the Santa Clara City Council meeting rather than specific agenda items. It explains that the meeting is being held in a hybrid format, allowing residents to attend in person or participate remotely via Zoom or phone, and outlines how to submit written comments in advance.
keyTopics: Hybrid meeting format with in-person and remote options
Zoom access details (meeting link, ID, and dial-in phone number)
Instructions for submitting written public comments via eComment before the meeting
Use of the City's Legistar Calendar page for agenda access

milpitas.title: Milpitas City Council — April 7, 2026
milpitas.summary: Milpitas City Council met to review changes to how federal housing and community development funding is allocated for 2025-2026, along with a list of new project ideas submitted by individual councilmembers. The council also considered changing the rules for how a vacant council seat gets filled and reviewed upcoming meeting schedules and agenda items.
keyTopics: Proposed changes to the 2025-2030 Consolidated Plan and 2025-2026 federal funding allocations for housing/community programs
New project and policy ideas submitted by individual councilmembers for future work
Proposed ordinance changes to how a City Council vacancy would be filled
Upcoming City Council meeting calendar and schedule
Approval of past meeting minutes and preview of items for the next council meeting

palo-alto.title: Palo Alto City Council — June 15, 2026
palo-alto.summary: The Palo Alto City Council honored retiring city figure Bill Gutoff with a proclamation, then held a required public hearing on proposed increases to water, wastewater, and refuse (garbage) rates. The Finance Committee recommended the Council adopt seven resolutions setting new utility rates and financial plans for the upcoming fiscal year.
keyTopics: Retirement proclamation honoring Bill Gutoff
Proposition 218 public hearing on utility rate increases
Water rate schedule changes (W-1, W-2, W-3, W-4, W-7) and reserve fund transfers
Wastewater collection rate changes (S-1, S-2, S-6, S-7) and financial forecast
Refuse/garbage collection rate adjustments (R-1, R-C)
